title: Cosmoprof Worldwide Bologna lifts the veil on the industry behind beauty
summary: Ahead of its 60th anniversary in 2027, Cosmoprof Worldwide Bologna is launching The Invisible Beauty, a communication project highlighting the people, expertise and collaborations that underpin the cosmetics industry beyond the glamour of finished products. As Cosmoprof Worldwide Bologna prepares to celebrate its 60th anniversary in 2027, the international beauty trade show is turning the spotlight towards the people, processes and expertise that create beauty products.
